title: Reasonable pricing
text: When I first subscribed to the box I was extremely excited to receive the products to try.  My last 2 boxes (including this months), were missing 2 products according to the information booklet that comes inside the box. I have been disappointed.  Although some of the products sent have been fabulous some of them are just horrible.  They seem like products that no one would purchase so they threw them in with the box you receive.  At first I gave it 5 stars but now I downgraded to a 3.  I might try Ipsy or a few of the other subscriptions.
label: neutral
